description: World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS) provides access to international merchandise trade, tariff and non-tariff measures data, with trade and development indicators, product views at HS 6-digit level and tools such as a tariff simulation tool, TRIST and country comparisons. It is run by the World Bank in partnership with UNCTAD, the UN Statistics Division, the WTO and the International Trade Centre, and draws on UN Comtrade and UNCTAD TRAINS. Coverage is global, by reporting country, partner and product, with annual series; country profiles give exports and imports by product group, for example chemicals (HS 28 to 38). Access is through the web interface, a bulk download and an API; profiles are open, while custom queries need a free registration, and the source data keep the terms of their original publishers. Caveats: WITS re-serves other agencies' data, so mirror statistics, reporting gaps and revisions of UN Comtrade carry over, and the page read does not state a licence. For simulation it is used to build bilateral trade networks for network-flow and cascading failure models of industrial supply chains and to test tariff or disruption scenarios. It is related to the UN Comtrade and CEPII BACI records in this catalogue, which hold the underlying and reconciled trade flows.
